github_actions.reason: Actual job annotations reject startup because account payments or spending limit; not a test failure.

website.old_url_behavior: GET and HEAD return 410 with an explicit link to the current install page, no APK attachment and no-store. Query and Range do not bypass retirement. Original hash URLs never return different APK bytes.
website.network_recovery: One idempotent GET timeout recovered on its single retry; no certificate validation relaxation.
website.purge_scope: Current deployment has run_worker_first=true, returns 410 before ASSETS APK reads, and does not use a separate response cache. Origin retirement was verified live; no cache-management privilege expansion was needed.

local_checks.earlier_packaging_failure: Two new fixture URLs used the real public hostname outside the allowed public URL forms, causing the privacy scan and dependent packaging tests to reject. Fixtures now use a reserved test hostname; runtime code and scan policy were not weakened.

limits: Public retirement does not remove existing browser caches, downloaded CLI/APK files or installed versions on other devices.
Compatibility relays may still serve existing paired clients and were not treated as unused merely because their protocol or preview version is older.
This is not a complete product/platform acceptance or a deletion of all historical files.
Retirement-aware rebuilds must be used for future website rollback; deploying an older retirement-unaware Worker can expose old downloads again.
No additional phone, personal-AI, long-idle or iOS acceptance is claimed.
